headline: PwC rolls out Claude agents firm-wide on a quiet day
body: A quiet day with one story. PwC said it will roll out Anthropic's Claude Code and Cowork across its workforce, certifying tens of thousands of staff. Large-scale use of AI agents nudges up AI Autonomy, which gives a tiny lift to the endings where AI acts on its own, such as Benevolent Dictator, Descendants and Zookeeper. Horizon Balance is 2.1, barely changed.
movers_note: Only small moves today: Benevolent Dictator +0.08, from the PwC agent rollout (+0.09); Enslaved God -0.07, from the PwC agent rollout (-0.04) and fading earlier news (-0.02).
